title: Data Viz lab 2 (source of the round-2 templates)
summary: The 8 comps the round-2 Data Viz templates were built and verified in: column chart, stacked bar, progress rings, comparison bars, timeline, waffle chart, area chart (masked reveal) and data table.
use_when: You want to see a round-2 chart template working before using it, change its data and rebuild, or re-extract a template with comp_to_template.py.
carvercat_version: built and verified in Carvercat 0.1.6 (rev 1105,; public release binary, headless; pack added to the bundled Library for the test), 2026-10-27
copy_notes: Each comp has a 'Lab bg' rectangle; templates are extracted with --drop "Lab bg".
Clip ids are unique per comp (dcc_, dsb_, dpr_, dba_, dtl_, dwf_, dac_, ddt_).
Area chart mask: the Window is the mask (isMask) and the Area its target; mask.make takes the FIRST id as the mask.
Rebuild: ai/scripts/motion/data_viz_lab2.py writes the comps; apply its PRESETS with preset.apply, run mask.make + parent.clear for MASKS, then edit.save.
Every comp lints 0 errors / 0 warnings / 0 notes.
source: Carvercat team, built with an AI agent, 2026-10-27
